about.title: Building Secure, Scalable Payment & Distributed Systems
about.description: I am an Associate Software Developer at Aurus Inc. contributing to mission-critical fintech payment infrastructure in the ECST team. My work spans secure iFrame PayPage integrations, wallet transaction processing, merchant validation pipelines, and one-time token generation for downstream transaction authorization. I am also actively migrating legacy configuration systems to Infinispan Distributed Cache and MariaDB to elevate performance, data isolation, and maintainability.

experience.heading: Professional Work Experience
experience.description: Demonstrated experience engineering enterprise-grade payment infrastructure and distributed backend applications.

points: Developed and enhanced an e-commerce payment platform using Java, Spring Boot, FTLH, JavaScript, CSS, and MariaDB, supporting iframe, PayPage, Pay by Link, Hosted PayPage, and wallet solutions.
Worked on iframe and PayPage workflows, including session generation, validation, dynamic page rendering, and integration with DS, Switch, and ATV services.
Implemented secure browser-to-backend communication using AES-256-GCM, RSA-OAEP, HMAC, and SHA-256 for payload encryption, key protection, integrity validation, and secure request processing.
Contributed to card payment and OTT flows and integrations with Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal, supporting Pre-Auth, Sale, Capture, Void, Refund, and Re-Auth operations.
Worked on merchant onboarding, Infinispan caching, and YAML-to-MariaDB configuration migration, along with WAR deployments via SSH across primary and secondary data centers.
